value.name: EligibilityCriterionItem
value.description:
Category: Reproduction
  ↳ (a) Women of childbearing potential must:
  ↳ - Have a negative pregnancy test on the day of screening and on Day 1
  ↳ - Use one highly effective form of birth control for at least 28 days prior to Day 1 and agree to continue using one highly effective form of birth control through 60 days following administration of the second dose of study intervention. A highly effective method of contraception is defined as one that can achieve a failure rate of less than 1\% per year when used consistently and correctly (see Table 6). Periodic abstinence, the rhythm method, and withdrawal are NOT acceptable methods of contraception.
